transcriber_notes: Boundaries printed on right axis (4.296 px/cm). Hardness from bar edges in pixels (class spacing 116 px; thirds as +/-). TEMPERATURE AXIS IS IN FAHRENHEIT (-16 to 32 F); values converted to C. The pixel geometry is the same as the C-labelled Avanet charts (32 F = 0 C at x~994 px, 20.64 px/C): with it, the vertices from 150 cm down fall on 0.5 C steps and the air-temperature segment ends at -9.7 C (= 14.5 F, printed as 15 F), so the snow temperatures were probably entered in C. Reading the F tick labels directly (left-aligned labels, 11.58 px/F) would give values up to ~0.4 C colder near the ground. Vertices of the unmarked polyline: +-0.2 C / +-1.5 cm (the 110 cm vertex lies under the red highlight line). Red line at 110 cm assigned to the layer on whose bar edge it is drawn (149-110).
